name: Call to Passion
source:
You're just an average gamer, spending most of your time avoiding people and glued to your screen. Then, BAM! Truck-kun strikes, and you're whisked away to a magical world torn apart by conflict between rival creature factions. You have no idea how or why you're here, but one thing's for sure: you're here for a reason. You're quickly captured by a group of goblins and brought to their town as a prisoner, where the goblin leader's daughter takes a keen interest in you.

What happens next is entirely up to you! Will you plot your escape from these monstrous captors and journey to a human town you've heard whispers of? Will you find a way to coexist peacefully with your goblin captors? Will you strive to unite all the warring factions and usher in an era of peace and harmony? Or will you lead armies of monsters and humans into epic battles against your enemies? The fate of this world rests in your hands.

[From [url=https://crystaldoorstudios.itch.io/call2passion]itch.io[/url]]
